title: Home Claim Payout Amount Leaderboard
dataSources: Lemonade policies (`lemonade:policy`), home claims (`claim:home`), premium bills (`homeinsurance:premium`), and renewal offers (`homeinsurance:renewal`).
app: Lemonade policy exports, home claim filings, premium billing snapshots, renewal offer logs, and coverage review notes streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=claim:home payout_usd=*
| stats sum(payout_usd) as total_value, avg(payout_usd) as avg_value by claim_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks claim type values by total and average payout amount across home insurance claim events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `payout_usd` values for each home insurance claim event and review total and average payout amount by claim type.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total payout amount.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which claim type shows the biggest payout amount numbers in your home insurance claim data.
